name: eMACS J0325.4-0359 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J0325.4-0359, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj032540359-hubble
story: A massive, distant cluster of galaxies, found by the extended Massive Cluster Survey in an X-ray map of the whole sky and caught in a quick Hubble snapshot. The snapshot survey hunts for the most powerful gravitational lenses, clusters whose gravity bends the light of galaxies far behind them.

claims.text: eMACS J0325.4-0359 is a massive, distant (high-redshift) galaxy cluster
It belongs to the eMACS sample, found by the extended Massive Cluster Survey in ROSAT All-Sky Survey X-ray data
Hubble observed it in a snapshot program aimed at finding the most powerful gravitational lenses
